'''Porso Hill''' was an island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the hill served as the [[Borvo's prison camp|site]] of a temporary [[Prison/Legends|prison]] camp for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Liberation of enslavement camps|captured]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Porso Hill was [[Attack on Porso Hill|attacked]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], who defeated Borvo and rescued the slaves from the [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal's]] base.

==Description==
Porso Hill was an island located in a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Color/Legends|gray]] hill was flat at its top and had five extensions, which sloped down into the water. It was found inside a canyon with only two chokepoints as entrances. Many small, [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] islands surrounded the canyon, and one of the islands had [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on it.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
As of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''Battle for Naboo'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the islands surrounding Porso Hill had [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] and [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile launchers]] placed on them. One of the islands also held a vehicular [[Laser/Legends|weapons]] upgrade hidden behind a grove of trees.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] established a [[Borvo's prison camp|camp]] on Porso Hill around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the invasion for his criminal [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization]]. The camp included a [[Hangar/Legends|docking station]] for his [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|freighter]] as well as eight [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> He put [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] whom he planned to sell in a makeshift [[Prison/Legends|prison]] there<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|38|Portho Hill}}</ref> after [[Liberation of enslavement camps|rescuing]] them from the invading Trade Federation. Borvo's camp was [[Attack on Porso Hill|destroyed]] by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Royal Security Forces']] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]], led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], who was searching for Borvo to find justice for the Hutt's [[Search for Captain Kael|betrayal]] and murder of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]]. Sykes subsequently rescued Borvo's slaves and destroyed Borvo's [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. The Hutt fled Porso Hill and retreated to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
During the attack, Sykes located and picked up the vehicle upgrade from the island before proceeding to Porso Hill.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Porso Hill first appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. In the level in which it appears, the player's bonus objective is to find the hidden upgrade&mdash;advanced lasers&mdash;near the hill.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' includes an entry for Porso Hill, although it misidentifies the location as "Portho Hill."<ref name="CSWE" />
